# The Everything Educator

> Classroom resources for educators, built by educators who use them and thrive with them.

Printable and editable classroom resources for teachers: world language (Spanish), elementary,
special education, ABA, speech and language, SEL and secondary subjects. Files are sold on
Teachers Pay Teachers; this site carries free downloads and practitioner how-to pages.
